value.data: Prestige Waterford offers spacious 3 and 4 BHK apartments in Pattandur Agrahara, East Bangalore.. Launched in 2020 and completed in 2023, it is a ready-to-move project with a futuristic design.. Configurations: 3 BHK, 4 BHK

Residents generally appreciate Prestige Waterford for its spacious apartments, good security, and a variety of amenities, along with its strategic location near IT hubs and essential services. However, common frustrations include significant traffic congestion, limited parking, and high maintenance costs.
